description: Verify that the UDP user interface allows creation of N new receive ports — TC8 spec asserts DUT can create 10 receive ports on demand via OpCreateUdpReceivePorts (RFC 768 'User Interface' MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 768 'User Interface' lists creation of new receive ports as a required UDP service primitive. TC8 v3.0 quantifies it: DUT must be able to provision at least 10 ports when asked. This case sends OpCreateUdpReceivePorts and asserts DUT reports the requested count.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpCreateUdpReceivePorts (count = 10)

2. Observation:
   • DUT confirms creation of 10 receive ports (via UT-query response)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
UT confirmation reports created port count == requested count.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_port_count — DUT created a different number of ports than requested
• Fail_timeout — UT-query never returned a creation confirmation

verdicts.Pass: DUT created the requested receive port count — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_port_count: DUT did not create the requested receive port count
